summary: Candidate 2 improves FTP recall to 0.754 vs production 0.000 on independent data, but benign recall 0.718 is low / the lower CI bound is 0.595, per-capture consistency 0.89, artifact-dependent=True. Not sufficient to promote.
caveats: Independent test is small: 36 captures / 420 flows, loopback lab, 2 classes.
CIs are wide; no strong statistical-significance claim is made.
Two server implementations (custom + pyftpdlib); single-host (no separate interface).
